researcher_notes: Current MEED ref live, confirms MGS-3 contractor awards (under construction). Blackridge profile independently lists 'Under Construction' (Q2 2024 start, Q4 2028 completion); SICIM (EPC contractor) lists project in-progress. 2+ independent -> high.
MGS transports natural gas. MEED and SICIM both describe the Master Gas System as a natural-gas network. 2+ independent -> high.
Long-distance East-West gas transport (transmission) lines. MEED and Blackridge both describe them as gas transport pipelines across the east-west corridor. 2+ independent -> high.

Current Aramco.com ref consistently times out (ReadTimeout, unverifiable) -> DEAD_LINK; replaced. Blackridge gives 'Project Completion Date Q4 2028'; SICIM (EPC contractor) lists completion 2028. StartYear1=2028 reflects planned in-service/completion year. 2+ independent -> high.

Each East-West corridor carries TWO parallel 56-in lines (EWGP-3 and EWGP-4). MEED and Blackridge both report the corridor TOTAL of 300 km for this segment; the GEM per-line value 150.00 km is half the corridor total (one of the two parallel lines). The literal per-line figure is not printed on the sources (hence value-not-found on MEED), but it is the corroborated half-of-corridor split -> medium. Reviewer: confirm the per-line vs corridor convention is intended.
56-inch East-West gas pipelines (lines 3 and 4). MEED, Blackridge and SICIM all state 56-inch diameter. 2+ independent -> high.

Located in Saudi Arabia (East-West Pipeline corridor across the Kingdom). MEED and SICIM both place MGS-3 in Saudi Arabia; Blackridge also confirms. Country-level only; segment endpoints (EWPS pump stations) not pinned to towns in public sources. 2+ independent -> high.

Owner Saudi Aramco (100%). One current ref (Aramco.com) times out and is unverifiable; MEED stays. Added SICIM (client = Saudi Aramco) and Blackridge (owner = Saudi Aramco) as independent corroboration. 2+ independent -> high.
FILL: MGS-3 carries sales/natural gas across the East-West corridor. MEED and SICIM both describe it as a natural-gas system. 2+ independent -> high.

Capacity unresolved: sources give only SYSTEM-WIDE MGS figures (Blackridge: +3.2 bscfd to 15.7 bscfd total; Tube&Pipe India: raise to 12.5 bscfd / +821 km). No per-segment/per-line throughput published for these individual East-West lines, so no defensible per-row Capacity. Left blank per best-effort rule.
